cohort: Pregnant women who delivered between January 1, 2012, and December 31, 2018
finding: Women with a BMI > 25 had a higher risk of cesarean section, preeclampsia, high-risk pregnancy, Apgar score < 7 at one minute, and macrosomia.
mod_finding: Women with a BMI > 25 had a higher risk of cesarean section compared to women with a lower BMI.
